snippet.title: FUSER - GAMEPLAY REVEAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
Welcome to the non-stop digital music festival where YOU control the music! Mix the hits, master the stage, and compete & collaborate with the world to become the ultimate headliner! Share your inspired mixes and mind-blowing performances in-game and online, from a library of over 100 songs including tracks from the world’s top artists. FUSER™ arrives Fall 2020. 

Pre-order now!

#PlayFuser @FuserGame
